title: Calendar context lib: match receipt time to a meeting
userStory: As a professional, my receipt is matched to the meeting I was in so it can be billed to that client.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/calendarContext.js exports findEventForReceipt(capturedAt, events, { windowMinutes = 90 }) - PURE: overlapping event wins, else nearest start within the window, else null; empty events -> null. Test fixtures pin explicit UTC offsets so matching is deterministic across timezones.

Exports getReceiptCalendarContext(capturedAt, { calendar }) - INJECTABLE calendar provider (real default lazily requires expo-calendar, requests FULL calendar access since iOS has no read-only events scope, getEventsAsync around capturedAt; fake in tests). Denied/none -> null.

Exports deriveBillable(event) -> { billable, client, project } (conservative title/attendee/organizer heuristic) and attachCalendarContext(receipt, calContext) -> NEW receipt with context.calendar + context.billable (pure).
npm test passes with fakes: match / nearest / outside-window / empty; deriveBillable client-titled vs personal; getReceiptCalendarContext denied -> null.
